headline: Yingtan Optimizes Housing Provident Fund Policies, Multiple New Benefit Policies Take Effect From November
summary: Yingtan City will let employees with no outstanding provident fund loan apply for first-home provident fund loans when buying a self-occupied home. The changes take effect from November.
why: Housing provident fund loans are a state-backed mortgage channel in China, and local easing affects property demand and mortgage credit.
